description: Details pursuant to the discharge of Conditions 4 (refuse storage), 5 (car-free) 6 (cycle storage), 7 (electric vehicle charging) of planning permission ref. 79657/APP/2025/2686, dated 17-12-25 (Erection of a single storey side and rear wrap around extension, insertion of window to first floor flank wall, change of use from single family residential to 5 bed 5 person HMO.)
application_type_full: Approval of details reserved by a condition (discharge)
decision_conditions: Insufficient information has been provided to discharge the requirements of  Condition 6 of  Appeal Decision 6005048. Specifically, Condition 6 requires the provision of accessible covered and secure cycle storage for 5 no. bicycles within the frontage.  The proposal is in conflict with the requirements of  Policy T6  of The London Plan (2021) and Policy DMT6 of Hillingdon Council's Local Plan Part 2 (2020).
